1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 g6 4.d4 exd4 5.N.strategy: Guards the d4 knight a second time and develops with a purpose, so the knight can stay in the centre without being exchanged. White keeps the more active position.
Develops so that the knight can recapture on c6 without doubling pawns, and keeps the long diagonal of the g7 bishop open, which a knight on f6 would block.
